llm.summary: The skill is mostly a catalyst-design reference skill, but it tells agents to persistently update its own methodology files while also claiming it only reads files.

dimensions.detail: The requested reading of bundled references and optional web lookup are proportionate for catalyst advice, but persistent methodology updates can alter future agent behavior and should be user-controlled.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a markdown-only skill with README install instructions for SkillHub CLI or manual copying into skills directories; no executable install scripts were present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The workflow and update protocol instruct backfilling design_methodology.md and methodology_registry.md, but the safety statement says the skill only reads its references/templates and does not write files, creating a material disclosure mismatch.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The dynamic update mechanism persists new rules into installed skill knowledge-base files, with append/audit guidance but no clear explicit user consent, rollback, or containment requirement.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The catalyst-design purpose matches the included references, registry, update protocol, and proposal template; optional WebSearch/WebFetch is limited to tracing methodology sources.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with the agent being instructed to update the skill's own methodology and registry files. Prefer using it read-only, or require explicit approval before any backfill/update to installed skill files.
llm.findings: [SDI-4] expected: A dynamic methodology update feature is coherent with the skill's stated evolvable catalyst-design purpose, but the artifact-backed conflict with the safety statement and lack of explicit user-controlled persistence justify Review rather than treating it as purely benign.
